intro.label: Intro
intro.title: Know what’s real.
intro.body: Choose a step to see how a forensic review of a face works, or select a region to learn what analysts look for.

scan.label: Scan
scan.title: Map the face.
scan.body: Facial landmarks locate the eyes, nose, mouth and jawline so each region can be examined on its own.
scan.note: Landmarks only locate regions. They do not show that anything was manipulated.

inspect.label: Inspect
inspect.title: Inspect the details.
inspect.body: Analysis concentrates on the boundaries where edits tend to leave traces: around the eyes, along the mouth and at the edge of the face.

explain.label: Explain
explain.title: Turn signals into evidence.
explain.body: Findings are written up region by region, and provenance is checked separately, so your team can see how a conclusion was reached.

handoff.label: Your image
handoff.title: Now inspect your own image.
handoff.body: Upload a photo in the next section. A few free checks every day, no account needed.

eyeL.label: Eye region · left
eyeL.body: The eyes and lids are compared for consistent reflections, sharpness and blending along the lid line.

eyeR.label: Eye region · right
eyeR.body: The eyes and lids are compared for consistent reflections, sharpness and blending along the lid line.

mouth.label: Mouth boundary
mouth.body: The lip line and mouth corners are where face swaps and lip re-animation most often leave blending or texture seams.

jaw.label: Face boundary
jaw.body: The jaw and cheek contour is where a replaced face meets the original head, so edges and lighting are checked for mismatches.

regions.caveat: This is a region-level visualization of what an analysis looks at. A highlighted region is not, on its own, evidence of manipulation.
